title: kerberos: avoid false negatives for 'kerberos.missing_keytype'
description:
First try to grab tgs_authenticator_subkey from the request
in order to force usage 9.

In the try and error with usage 8 or 9
we should avoid reporting 8 as missing if we
were able to decrypt using 9.

The fallback from 8 to 9 is still required for incomplete captures.

  949 |         if (private_data->PA_TGS_REQ_subkey != NULL) {
      |                         ^~```

commits_data.message:
kerberos: avoid false negatives for 'kerberos.missing_keytype'

First try to grab tgs_authenticator_subkey from the request
in order to force usage 9.

In the try and error with usage 8 or 9
we should avoid reporting 8 as missing if we
were able to decrypt using 9.

The fallback from 8 to 9 is still required for incomplete captures.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
